reviews.comment:
Cómo siempre San Juan dando lastima en sus servicios, en esta ocasión, está “ypf de las Flores” “estación de servicio”( no merece ese nombre) ubicada a pocos Km de aduana Argentina para el paso a Chile. 3/1/25 temporada alta, miles de autos…y los señores abren de 7 a 23??? Encima llegan a atender con mala cara, no hay servicio de agua caliente, no podes pagar con débito ni otros modos de pago que no sea efectivo….podria seguir diciendo todo malo de este lugar.
Bueno no existe calificacion para esto, que no sirve pra nada.
De modo que cdo salgan de sus casas, ignoren que existe posibilidad de cargar nafta aquí.

(Translated by Google)
As always, San Juan's services are pathetic. This time, it's the "YPF de las Flores" gas station (it doesn't deserve that name), located a few kilometers from the Argentine border crossing into Chile. It was January 3, 2025, peak season, with thousands of cars... and the staff are only open from 7 AM to 11 PM??? On top of that, they're rude when they arrive, there's no hot water, and you can't pay with debit or any payment method other than cash... I could go on and on listing all the bad things about this place. Well, there's no way to describe it; it's completely useless.
So, when you leave your house, forget about the possibility of getting gas here.
